answers.rationale: The requirement specifies metal-clad switchgear with detailed construction and ratings. CROWN-ARMV is the appropriate product as it is arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear designed for heavy-duty utility service, meeting IEEE standards and customizable to the specified ratings.

The general arrangement of switchgear breaker and auxiliary units is part of the design and configuration of the metal-clad switchgear. CROWN-ARMV is suitable as it is engineered to order and can be arranged per contract documents.

The requirement specifies features of the switchgear doors and safety mechanisms. CROWN-ARMV includes customizable features such as hinged doors, safety shutters, and internal lighting, aligning with the specification.

Connections to voltage transformers and cable specifications are part of the switchgear design. CROWN-ARMV supports 15 kV rated cable connections and can be engineered to meet fault and momentary current ratings.
Nameplates and labeling are part of the switchgear specification. CROWN-ARMV can include detailed nameplates and labeling as per customer requirements.
Factory installation of components is standard for engineered switchgear. CROWN-ARMV is delivered with all components installed except those specified as furnished by the purchaser.

Accessibility and cable entry features are part of the switchgear design. CROWN-ARMV includes front-accessible metering, relaying, and control equipment, as well as bolted removable panels and bottom cable entry.
The specification for power cable compartment doors aligns with the construction features of CROWN-ARMV, which includes robust door designs with locking mechanisms and weatherproofing.
Drawout carriages with grounding devices for mounting transformers are part of the switchgear design. CROWN-ARMV supports such features and can be engineered to meet this requirement.
